# Jan-Marlon Leibl · Full context

## Identity

Jan-Marlon Leibl is a software developer based in Bremen, Germany. He communicates in German and English and can be reached at hi@itsjan.dev. His public website is https://itsjan.dev.

Jan started coding at age 11 in C# after a friend showed him a small application. He completed a three-year software development apprenticeship at team neusta in Bremen from 2023 to 2026.

## Current focus

Jan is building Finny, a receipt and warranty-reminder app. Finny keeps receipt and purchase details together and reminds people before a warranty expires. The public product site is https://fnny.app.

## Experience

### Finny · Bremen · 2026 to present

Jan is building Finny with TypeScript, React, and Next.js. The product focuses on useful reminders and keeping purchase information easy to find.

### team neusta · Bremen · 2023 to 2026

Jan completed his software development apprenticeship at team neusta. He worked on client projects using PHP, TypeScript, TYPO3, Symfony, and Git, alongside vocational school at Schulzentrum SII Utbremen.

### Ventry · 2023 to 2024

Jan built Ventry, a temporary file-sharing service. It creates links that expire and remove the shared file after the share period. The project is available at https://ventry.host.

## Technical areas

- Backend and services: PHP, Symfony, APIs
- Frontend and applications: TypeScript, React, Next.js
- CMS and client work: TYPO3
- Infrastructure and tooling: Cloudflare, Docker, Git, Bun, Tailwind CSS
- AI-assisted development: Claude, Codex, Gemini, Perplexity, Cursor, and VS Code
